records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

If you haven't had a chance to set up your first project yet, now's a great time -- it's the quickest way to see what Wrenfield is for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Cedar Collective
records.body:
Hi Sofia,

Thanks for joining Wrenfield. If this is your first project-management tool for the team, the biggest adjustment is usually just getting into the habit of logging tasks here instead of a doc or a chat thread.

Happy to help with that transition.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 ([email:7d6660be] nudge era) and welcome call held ([calendar:cfd5bd48]), showing engagement; but no invites sent, no customer replies, and 6 days with no key milestone on a Starter solo account leave only 8 days, so unaided activation is possible but below even odds.

draft.subject: Next step after our welcome call
draft.body:
Hi Sofia,

Great to talk last week about getting Cedar Collective's work out of docs and chat threads and into Wrenfield. You've got your first project set up, which is the hard part -- projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them.

The usual next step is bringing in the people doing the work: a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through it with you.

Best,
Nadia
